clauses.quote: The work year for eleven-month Teachers shall be two hundred ten (210) days.
clauses.subject_text: The work year for eleven-month Teachers

clauses.quote: ET 15/11 Teachers shall receive the same holidays and breaks as ET 15 Teachers, including July 4th, the day after Thanksgiving and winter and spring breaks.
The work year for twelve-month Teachers shall be 228 days.
clauses.subject_text: The work year for twelve-month Teachers

clauses.quote: ET 15/12 Teachers shall receive the same holidays and breaks as ET 15 Teachers, including July 4th, the day after Thanksgiving and winter and spring breaks.
EG-09 Teachers shall receive the same holidays and breaks as ET 15 Teachers, including July 4th, the day after Thanksgiving and winter and spring breaks.

The work day for ET-15 and ET-15/12 Teachers shall be seven-and-one-half (7.5) consecutive hours beginning no earlier than 7:30 AM and ending no later than 4:30 PM, inclusive of a duty-free lunch period, except as provided for elsewhere in this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: The work day for ET-15 and ET-15/12 Teachers

clauses.quote: The workweek for EG-09 Teachers shall be forty (40) hours.
Individual Teacher schedules and the schedules of groups of teachers in their respective Schools may be adjusted
clauses.subject_text: Individual Teacher schedules and the schedules of groups of teachers in their respective Schools

clauses.quote: in no case shall a Teacher’s schedule exceed the length of the workday specified above without the Teacher’s consent or as otherwise provided for in this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Functionally negated by 'in no case', though the verb phrase itself lacks a direct 'not'.

clauses.quote: Teachers shall, immediately upon their arrival, record in the main office of their School the time of their arrival
shall report to their classroom or place duty at least thirty-five (35) minutes prior to the start of the official school day for students.
Teachers shall record in the main office of their School the time of their departure at the end of the school day.
Itinerant Teachers shall record the time of their arrival and departure in the main office of each of their assigned Schools.
Teachers shall not be required to use time clocks.

Teachers shall have the right to leave the School building during their duty-free lunch period provided they return at the end of the lunch period in time to perform their scheduled duties and responsibilities.
DCPS shall announce any emergency closing via the DCPS website at the earliest possible time.
